content.text:
Machine: Atlas Copco GA oil-injected rotary screw air compressor, industrial duty
Time unit: hour
Component: Oil separator element (OS): the coalescing element that separates oil from the compressed air
Fault mode: clogging: the element loads with oil residue, so the pressure drop across it rises

Give the life range of this component under this fault mode.

unit.description:
The given time unit, or the unit of an amount processed.

{minLength: 1}
unit.title: Unit

system.text:
You estimate how long a machine component lasts before it must be replaced, cleaned or restored, for one way it degrades. No document states this life; your range becomes a deliberately wide prior that measured data will narrow later, so state honestly how uncertain it is.

Give the range as the 5th and 95th percentile (`low`, `high`) of the life across machines like this one in normal service, under the given fault mode only:
- `unit`: the machine's time unit you are given, as written there. Use instead the unit of an amount processed (litres or cubic metres of water treated, kilograms, cycles) only when the life of this kind of component is normally stated as such an amount, as for a water filter's capacity. Never a calendar unit (day, month, year) unless it is the time unit you are given.
- `low` and `high`: numbers in that unit, low below high. Prefer a wide range to a narrow wrong one; a factor of ten between them is normal for a component class.
- `basis`: one or two sentences on the component class and conditions the range rests on. Do not cite manufacturer documents or numbers you have not been given.

responses.text: {"life":{"unit":"hour","low":1200,"high":9000},"basis":"Oil separator elements in oil-injected rotary screw compressors clog as oil residue loads the coalescing media, and life depends strongly on operating temperature, oil carryover, ambient dust ingress, and load cycling under industrial duty. This wide prior is not anchored to any given document, so the true spread for this unit may be narrower or shifted, and measured pressure-drop data should replace it."}

{"life":{"unit":"hour","low":1200,"high":8000},"basis":"Oil separator elements in oil-injected rotary screw compressors of this class usually load with oil residue over a few thousand running hours, with shorter lives where ambient air is dusty or hot, the oil is degraded, or the machine runs at high load. The range is a deliberately wide prior for clogging only, not a value taken from any document, and measured pressure-drop data should narrow it considerably."}
